brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

finish.summary: A tabletop sewing organizer: three full hex cells in a triangle, bolted together, with bottom covers and caps on every open edge. Each cell holds a different bin: 3 compartments, 2 compartments, or one open bin. A hook plate on one side holds scissors or a tape measure. 24 parts. check_build passes with no issues and meshClash is clear.

requirements.requirement: Small, sorted storage for notions (pins, needles, buttons, bobbins)
Open space for larger items (thread spools, tape, fabric scraps)
requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, a full-depth bin with no dividers

requirements.requirement: A place to hang scissors or a tape measure
requirements.evidence: accessory:0#1,0#0 hook plate (2 hooks) on cell 1,0. It is checked for fit only; no load rating is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Holds together and sits flat on a table, with tidy finished edges
requirements.evidence: 3 joint bolts join the cells, 3 bottom covers close the base, and 11 caps finish the open edges. check_build passes with no issues and meshClash is clear. The covers close the base, but no feet were added.
24 parts and one level, about 3 hex cells across

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
